rounds.title: Toolbar baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK toolbar, drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page. et-toolbar itself is a transparent flex row (4px gap, 4px padding, 8px radius, no edge); the drawing composes it as its story does: sm transparent et-icon-buttons (31px, 18px icon) in color surface that take the surrounding theme while pressed (pressedColor inherit, so pressed = 16 percent primary tint with the icon in theme ink), two decorative et-dividers splitting three groups, and the story's own chrome (surface background, 1px --et-surface-border-solid edge, fit-content). Bold and Bulleted list are pressed, Link is no toggle; the first enabled control holds the roving tab stop (tabindex 0, the rest -1). The toolbar has no overflow handling. States: default, hover, active, focus-visible (pressed Bold), focus-visible-unpressed (Italic holds the tab stop), disabled (Italic), vertical. Numbers (light / dark): unpressed icons in surface ink 17.93 / 17.18 on the fill; pressed icon in theme ink on the pressed tint 5.07 / 9.24; hover and active keep icons above 10.7. Pressed vs unpressed: the pressed tint against the toolbar fill is only 1.08 / 1.46, the pressed icon against an unpressed icon 3.27 / 1.27 - on light the state rests mostly on a dark-green vs black icon. Focus ring today: on a pressed control it is the focused mint, 1.38:1 against the page and 1.28 against the pressed tint on light, under 3:1 (WCAG 2.4.11 / 1.4.11); dark 13.06 / 8.94. On an unpressed control it is the surface neutral, 10.37 / 13.07. Q98, numbers only: toolbar fill vs page 1.00 / 1.00 (story fill equals the page), story edge vs page 1.26 / 1.73, divider vs fill 1.26 / 1.73, pressed tint vs page 1.08 / 1.46, hover tint 1.14 / 1.18 (pressed 1.10 / 1.85), active tint 1.40 / 1.60 (pressed 1.32 / 1.87). Q101 does not arise: no filled button, a pressed toggle is tonal. Variant b applies decided rules only: Q88 every focus ring in --et-theme-color-ink-solid; Q99 rule a - the pressed toggle's mint fill gets a 1px inset ink edge (the icons are already ink, no mint dot, stroke or text). b adds an edge, so Q102 is open and c is b with dark as today (no edge in dark).

a.note: Today: focus ring on a pressed control in the focused mint, 1.38:1 against the page on light (1.28 against the tint), under 3:1; dark 13.06. Pressed tint vs fill 1.08 light, 1.46 dark. Icons 17.93 / 17.18 unpressed, 5.07 / 9.24 pressed.

b.note: Pick. Decided rules Q88 and Q99a: every focus ring in ink, light 7.68:1 against the page and 7.11 against the pressed tint, dark 13.50 / 9.24; pressed toggles get a 1px inset ink edge, 5.48:1 against the toolbar fill on light and 13.50 on dark, so pressed reads by edge, not only by a 1.08 tint. Everything else as a.

c.note: As b on light (ink ring 7.68:1, ink edge on pressed 5.48:1); dark as today without the edge (Q102 open): pressed tint vs fill 1.46, ring 13.50 in ink (ink is the mint in dark).
